uutiset.t: Cobalt’s Outlook Darkens as Memory Chip Costs Hit Gadgets Demand
uutiset.s: Chinese cobalt demand is weakening as soaring prices for memory chips hit sales of the electronic gadgets that use the battery metal.

uutiset.t: Ping An Group To Reduce Public Equity Allocation
uutiset.s: Michael Guo, Ping An Group Co-CEO says the insurance company is planning to reduce allocation on public equity and considering fixed income as an alternative investment. He speaks to Bloomberg’s Stephen Engle in an exclusive interview at the APEC 2026 summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Quant Trader Graviton Expands Office Space in India, Singapore
uutiset.s: Graviton Research Capital LLP has expanded into larger offices in India’s high-frequency trading hub of Gurugram and in Singapore as the homegrown firm gears up for an ambitious global expansion.

uutiset.t: China Sets Strongest Yuan Fixing Since 2022 as APEC Begins
uutiset.s: China’s central bank lifted its daily yuan reference rate to the strongest in over four years, a sign of tolerance for gradual gains as it hosts a key regional summit.

uutiset.t: SQM Sees Positive Lithium Demand Outlook Even as Prices Slide
uutiset.s: Major lithium producer SQM continues to see “encouraging trends” in underlying demand as the industry confronts a renewed selloff in the battery metal and the prospect of rising supply next year.

uutiset.t: David Jones to Cut 1,500 Jobs in Survival Fight, Union Says
uutiset.s: Australian department store chain David Jones is set to cut about 1,500 jobs, one-quarter of the workforce, as it shuts outlets in a bid to survive, according to the employees’ union.

uutiset.t: Thailand Sees US Chip Curbs as Risk to Data Center Drive
uutiset.s: New US restrictions on the export and access to top-end semiconductors risks denting Thailand’s ambitions to be a hub for data centers, the foreign minister said. uutiset.t: Council on Foreign Relations’ McGuire on Trump-XI Meeting Implications for Chips
uutiset.s: Chris McGuire, Council on Foreign Relations' Senior Fellow on China and Emerging Technologies discusses US restrictions on Nvidia chip sales and remote access, as the US president prepares to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping at the APEC summit. uutiset.t: China Bank Rally Gains Momentum as Global AI Trade Unravels
uutiset.s: Chinese bank stocks are gaining a tailwind as turmoil around Nvidia Corp. deepens cracks in the artificial intelligence trade and drives investors toward defensive bets.

uutiset.t: Willy Shih on Risks With Nvidia’s Supply Chain
uutiset.s: Willy Shih, Harvard Business School professor of management practice, discusses how NVIDIA’s supplier network and rising purchase commitments help it reserve production capacity amid intense competition. He speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Australia Revamps Pension Fund Test to Unlock New Investment
uutiset.s: Australia’s government is overhauling the annual performance test for the nation’s pension funds, including introducing a new benchmark aimed at encouraging investment in a broader range of assets.

uutiset.t: China Is Finding Workarounds on Restrictions: Sara Hsu
uutiset.s: Sara Hsum University of Tennessee at Knoxville's Supply Chain Management Clinical Associate Professor says China has already been developing domestic supply chains and advanced semiconductors as a policy priority. She speaks with Romaine Bostick and Ed Ludlow on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Former Darden CEO: Cava Better Off As A Private Company
uutiset.s: Clarence Otis, Darden Restaurant's former Chairman and CEO discusses how restaurants are responding to rising food, labor and real estate costs as menu prices increase and consumers face more pressure on their budgets. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Nothing to Nitpick With Nvidia Results: Erika Klauer
uutiset.s: Ahead of NVIDIA’s results, Erika Klauer, CIO at Science and Technology Partners, says Jensen Huang has had an indelible impact on NVIDIA and the evolution of the AI business. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close". (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Gold Declines to 14-Month Low as Fed Officials Signal Rate Hikes
uutiset.s: Gold dropped to the lowest since September 2025 after Federal Reserve officials made the case for more interest-rate hikes to tackle stubborn inflation.
